placement_rule.instructions: Before every pair the operator places the cube at a new, haphazard point inside the region. Do not reuse a previous spot, do not line the points up, and keep at least 30 mm from the previous realized point. The measured point, not the operator intent, is the recorded site.

front_camera.note: The far bearing bounds follow the calibrated D435i far-field fan from the home pose. Its top-face measurement is used only to drive the base into the wrist band; the final grasp target is always the validated wrist measurement.

coverage.note: A random point outside this region has no locator from the home pose, so it is excluded by the placement rule rather than recorded as a grasp failure.
